hire_title: SAP S/4HANA Implementation Specialist for Mergers & Acquisitions
hire_description:
We are seeking a SAP S/4HANA implementation specialist to help large shipping companies navigate complex post-merger digital transformations. The ideal candidate will have experience with SAP S/4HANA and has successfully implemented ERP systems in multi-country environments, particularly in the context of mergers and acquisitions.

Key responsibilities include:
* Conducting a thorough assessment of the client's current finance system to identify areas for improvement
* Developing a comprehensive implementation plan that takes into account cultural differences and regulatory requirements across multiple countries
* Collaborating closely with internal stakeholders and IT teams to ensure smooth project execution and user adoption
* Implementing SAP S/4HANA ReFX and IFRS16 lease accounting compliance within an aggressive timeline of 5-8 months

hire_title: Develop AI solution for engineering requirements rewriting and metadata tagging
hire_description:
Develop an AI-based workflow to automate the rewriting and metadata tagging of 750 engineering documents. Requirements include: 
- Rewrite requirement statements using INCOSE and EARS standards.
- Assign metadata tags from a hierarchical taxonomy of over 1,000 options.
- Create cross-references and identify similar requirements.
- Implement via a web application using Generative AI and vector databases.
hire_description_additional_notes: Discipline engineers can dedicate only 20% of their time to validation. Solution must adhere to responsible AI governance principles.

hire_title: Implement managed finance function with ERP integration and multi-jurisdictional compliance
hire_description:
We are an impact investment firm with $1.7B in AUM that recently transitioned to an independent operating structure. We need to establish a fully functioning finance organization in under six months while keeping internal resources focused on investment growth. The solution must be cost-effective, scalable, and compliant across multiple jurisdictions.

Scope of work includes:
- Conduct a gap-fit analysis to recommend rapid data migration and onboarding solutions without lengthy system implementation.
- Deploy a pre-configured enterprise resource planning (ERP) system with standardized processes for transaction processing and management reporting.
- Provide specialized support for statutory and tax requirements across local jurisdictions via country specialists.
- Ensure audit readiness and reliable controls from day one to meet strict impact reporting standards.
hire_description_additional_notes: Timeline: Under six months for full function establishment. Seniority: Partner-led engagement with cross-domain professionals and country specialists. Budget: Must be cost-effective to avoid heavy internal build-out costs.

hire_title: Legal consultant for cross-border antitrust clearances and JV structuring
hire_description: We need legal counsel to structure a non-profit joint venture for a global blockchain trade data utility in the shipping industry. hire_title: AI solution to automate insurance claims processing from unstructured and semi-structured documents
hire_description: A Nordic insurer sought to automate its claims management process, which relied on agents manually reading scanned images, PDFs, bills, invoices, pharmacy receipts, clinic documents, and medical diagnoses, then extracting and categorizing the relevant data. We needed an AI-powered solution to convert semi-structured and unstructured documents into actionable structured data, feed it to our core claims system, and free agents to focus on customer relationships.
